data.script: const cached=Draft.find(draft.uuid),selection=editor.getSelectedRange(),source=editor.getText();draft.content=source+'\nUpdated café 🐼';draft.addTag('update-qa');draft.flagType=2;if(draft.update()!==undefined)throw new Error('update must return void');if(editor.getText()!==draft.content||cached.content!==draft.content||cached!==Draft.find(draft.uuid))throw new Error('update references diverged');if(JSON.stringify(editor.getSelectedRange())!==JSON.stringify(selection))throw new Error('update changed selection');
